plan.question: Does the negative endpoint reach exact black rather than retaining residual intensity?
hypotheses: H1: Linear multiplier 1+b/100 reaches zero at -100.
H2: Reciprocal negative multiplier 1/(1-b/100) retains half intensity at -100.
predictions: H1 predicts RGB=0 for every pixel, alpha=255.
H2 predicts outputs [0,32,64,127] for inputs [0,64,128,255], alpha=255.
plan.usefulness: Checks the parameter endpoint across the full intensity range, complementing the interior negative test. Require exact neutral roundtrip and keep all other controls at 0.
